dedupe_keys.name: citydoctor2 quality checking and repair of citygml city models

description: CityDoctor2 is quality-checking software for 3D city models in CityGML: a Java program that checks whether geometries and other criteria are met and reports the results, with a repair component (CityDoctorHealer) that works only as a prototype. It supports CityGML 3.0 with backwards compatibility for 2.0 and 1.0, needs Java 17 or later, outputs results as XML or PDF, and implements the QualityADE so results can be stored inside the CityGML file; the documentation lists geometric checks such as non-planar polygons, self-intersecting rings, unclosed solids and non-manifold edges. Coverage: any CityGML model. Access: validation library, GUI and healer are free and open source on HFT Stuttgart's GitLab, with release binaries (source active September 2026). Licence: GNU LGPL 3.0. Caveats: repair is not guaranteed to fix every error; documentation is partly German. Simulation uses: checking LoD2 and LoD3 building models before solar, energy or flood simulations that need closed, valid solids. Related records: the OGC CityGML standard and 3DCityDB.
